description: How what a runtime session of this image is made of is shown to a person: the groups and items of the plugins page (title, the one line a row carries, what it does, how it is used, its icon, its control, what it opens, what gates it, and the bundles, rows, skills and tool sets it accounts for), and under `plumbing` the reason for everything that has no item. Generated beside it: runtime-inventory.json, from the composition snapshot, the agent preset, the tool names, the skill roots and the LoopX record. packages/domain/test/runtimeInventory.test.mjs holds the two equal: a bundle, an enabled row, a skill root, a tool set or a LoopX skill that appears with no item and no reason fails there. Disabled rows are not mounted in a session and need no words.

loopx.title: 长任务
loopx.use: 给一个要做很多步的目标，它会自己一步步做下去，随时可以暂停。
loopx.does: 给它一个要做很多步的目标，它会在这个对话里自己一步步做下去，做完一步接着做下一步，直到做完；中途随时可以暂停、继续或查看进度。持续运行会消耗灵豆，可随时暂停。
loopx.how: 在输入框里输入 /，选择 loopx，写下目标。对话里会出现“长任务目标”栏，可以暂停、继续、看进度；有新进展时，收件箱会提醒你。

memory.title: 记忆
memory.use: 记住你说过的偏好和项目背景，下次对话自动带上。
memory.does: 对话里说到的偏好、背景和做法会被记下来，下次对话需要时自动带上。记下的内容可以在记忆页查看、修改或删除。
memory.how: 不需要设置，直接对话即可；想看或改它记了什么，打开记忆页。

citations.title: 文献引用核对
citations.use: 核对参考文献的 DOI 和 PubMed 记录，并按所需格式排版。
citations.does: 回答或报告里出现参考文献时，按 DOI、PMID 查回原始书目记录，标出查不到或信息不一致的条目，再按你要的格式（GB/T 7714、Vancouver 等）排版。
citations.how: 在当前项目里打开右侧的开关即可，下次对话生效；点开这一行可以调整请求超时。

toolSentences.cite_lookup: 按标题、DOI 或 PMID 查找文献书目
toolSentences.cite_format: 把参考文献排成 GB/T 7714 或 Vancouver 等格式
toolSentences.cite_check: 核对引用是否存在、信息是否一致

annotation.title: 划词批注
annotation.use: 在回答里选中一段话，直接追问或批注。
annotation.does: 在回答里选中一段话，可以直接就这一段追问，或留下批注，对话会带着你选中的原文继续。
annotation.how: 在回答里用鼠标选中一段话，点出现的“批注”，写下想说的话再发送。

diagrams.title: Mermaid 图表
diagrams.use: 把回答里的流程图代码画成图，例如流程图、架构图。
diagrams.does: 回答里的流程图代码会画成图，可以在图和代码之间切换，适合流程图、架构图、路线图和分类图，医学研究里也可以画 PRISMA 流程图。
diagrams.how: 直接让它画图，例如“把这个流程画成流程图”；图出现在回答里，可以切换到代码、全屏或下载。

web.title: 网页阅读
web.use: 读取公开网页和 PDF，遵守网站的抓取规则。
web.does: 你给出一个网址，或任务需要某个公开页面时，读取它的正文并保存成可引用的快照；遵守网站的抓取规则，按站点限速。
web.how: 把网址发给它，或直接说要查哪个网页；也可以让它先搜索，再读其中几个页面。

basics.title: 基础能力
basics.use: 待办清单、并行子任务、交付文件、向你确认、整理长对话、文件与命令。
basics.does: 每一次对话都有的基本功：列步骤、分头做事、把文件交到你手上、缺信息时问你、整理过长的对话，以及读写项目里的文件、运行命令。
basics.how: 不需要设置，直接提出任务即可，需要时它会自己用到。

parts.title: 待办清单
parts.does: 做步骤较多的事时，它会先列出步骤，边做边划掉，你能看到做到哪一步。

parts.title: 并行子任务
parts.does: 同时有几件互不相干的事时，可以分给子任务一起做，只把结果带回对话。

parts.title: 交付文件
parts.does: 做好的文件会交到你手上：在对话里直接预览或下载，也留在项目的文件里。

parts.title: 向你确认
parts.does: 缺了没法开始的信息时，它会在对话里问你，你回答后接着做。

parts.title: 整理长对话
parts.does: 对话变得很长时，输入 /compact 让它整理前文、保留要点，腾出空间。

parts.title: 文件与命令
parts.does: 读写项目工作区里的文件，搜索内容，运行脚本和命令，把中间结果留在工作区。

research-tools.title: 内置工具集
research-tools.use: 网页、知识库、定时任务，以及文献、药品说明书、试验登记等检索与计算工具。
research-tools.does: 对话里取数和计算都从这里来：读取和搜索公开网页，检索知识库，安排定时任务；医学和科研问题还可以检索文献、指南和试验登记，查药品说明书与不良反应，并做 Meta 分析、孟德尔随机化、文献计量等统计计算。
research-tools.how: 不需要选择，需要时它会自己调用；下面列出这个账号现在可用的工具。

bundles.@deepseek-ai/dsh-base: The kernel itself: sessions, storage, the model connection, sandbox, tools. Its rows are accounted for one by one under plumbing.rows, so a row a kernel update adds is a decision made here.
bundles.@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app: The kernel's web application: its host process and the conversation page. Rows accounted for one by one under plumbing.rows.
bundles.@evimed/dsh-socket: The platform's own composition for the kernel (the evimed-universal preset and its plugins). Its rows are listed under the items they serve, or under plumbing.rows.

rows.reason: The model connection and the turn loop: calls to the model through the gateway, retries and time limits, the system prompt, the tool catalogue, the context meter and the spill of large results. Nothing for a person to open or switch.
The slash-command registry and its replies; the commands themselves are listed where they belong (整理长对话 under 基础能力, 长任务), and the menu is the kernel's own.
The kernel's skill service. The skills it lists come from the skill roots, which the skills page lists group by group (see skillRoots).
The kernel's goal state and round driver, mounted without a command or tool of their own: goals are 长任务's, which stands on them.

Sessions, history and storage the kernel keeps for every conversation (JSONL log, query index, projections, checkpoints, titles, attachments, statistics, log export, message feedback). Reached through the conversation list.
The sandbox, the permission presets and the credential store the runtime keeps its work inside. What a person meets of them is the conversation's own approval card.

The kernel's own host process: web server and start-up, module loading, the API controllers and remotes, the workspace and its file reads, preset registry, settings storage and the format converter the preview uses.

The kernel's conversation page — composer, message list, side panels, theme, locale, shortcuts and settings panels — drawn inside the frame the web app hosts. Nothing separate to switch; the product's own pages are the web app's.
The kernel's web provider registry and its search provider; web reading and search are filled by the platform's own row, listed as 网页阅读, which goes through the control plane's gateways.

The frame's own client half: the upload button, theme, language and the goal-bar wording (`evimed-runtime-ui`), the read-only skill catalogue and plugin probe the control plane asks, the start-up seam check, the run's evidence mirror, the engine-task context and the agent preset. Plumbing: a person meets none of them by name.

agentRows.reason: The standing instruction: roles and principles only, mounted whatever the switches say.

The platform's delivery policy and its pieces: the standing guidance, plan and delegation checks, the evidence ledger, batch screening, the independent review where the review module is on, duplicate-line folding. They shape what a professional workflow delivers; nothing to switch or open.
The skill service of a session and the tool that loads one. The skills it can load are listed by the skills page.
The bridge installed extensions arrive in a session through. Extensions are listed from the extension centre's own catalogue (我的插件, 可以添加), one row each.

skills.reason: LoopX's own project, PR, benchmark, performance and documentation workflows. 长任务 drives them through the goal bar; the skills page lists the entry skill alone, because none of them is something a person starts.

toolSets.socket: The delivery workflow's tools (plan, delegate, await, submit, render, check, claims, review, compact request, capsule recall and note). The professional workflows and the run policy use them; a person never chooses one.

core.how: Each skill has a row in skill-display-zh.json (the skills page, 通用 and 写作与核查); a test holds the two equal.

evimed.how: open-domain-answer, listed under 通用 through skill-display-zh.json.

curated-scientific.how: The curated analysis skills, listed under 科研分析 through skill-display-zh.json.

office.how: Word, PDF, PowerPoint and Excel, listed under 办公文档 through skill-display-zh.json.

community.how: Listed by use (办公文档, 写作与核查) through skill-display-zh.json, never as a group of their own.

geo-private.how: The 循证 GEO method pack: its index (name and one sentence per skill, never a body) is what the skills page lists, for accounts the module is open to.

loopx.how: Only the entry skill, under 长任务; the rest are accounted for under plumbing.skills.

personal.how: The person's own skills (我的技能), read from the skill library.

platform-learned.reason: Handbooks the platform learned from the account's work; they have their own home, the 做法 of the memory page.
